about_the_game:
A thrilling, fast-paced climbing game where players unlock different boons and choose diverse paths to ascend each climb. Control a character in the form of a ball and unlock permanent upgrades to enhance your gameplay. Navigate past various traps as you face the constant risk of falling back to the start.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dynamic Climbing Mechanics: Master momentum-based movement to scale handcrafted levels.

  • Roguelike Progression: Unlock permanent upgrades (e.g., double jumps, speed boosts, or wall jumps) to tackle increasingly difficult climbs.

  • Risk vs. Reward: Choose between multiple paths—some safe but slow, others laden with traps but offering unique power-ups.

  • Diverse Hazards: Dodge spinning traps, collapsing platforms, laser turrets, and environmental hazards that punish careless moves.

WARNING: One wrong move could send you tumbling… but the thrill of the climb will keep you coming back!
